summary: Forest Lookouts lists a SCFC lookout at Loris, Horry County. No source we read describes the Loris tower itself; the story gives statewide SCFC context only.

facts.status_note: No source we read says whether the Loris tower stands today.

notes_for_editor: The only Loris-specific source is the Forest Lookouts page, which gives name, county and agency. Two web searches and several reads found nothing on the Loris tower itself. The Herald article on Horry County's towers timed out twice and was not read. A search snippet mentioned Horry County's four fire towers, which may include Loris, but that is unverified. The Post and Courier article is undated in the copy read.
